title: Monotone Viability Learning for Offline Safe Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.07616v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Offline safe reinforcement learning requires reliable long-horizon safety estimates from fixed data. Learning Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) viability in this setting calls for semantic preservation, convergence, and numerical stability. To address these challenges, we propose Monotone Viability Learning (MoViL), which learns viable sets from offline transitions through monotone finite-horizon set recursion. The recursion preserves finite-horizon safety semantics and converges to the infinite-horizon viability kernel. Binary supervision maintains a fixed target scale across horizons, avoiding discount-induced numerical attenuation. We further establish sufficient conditions for recovering behavior-supported viable subsets. The learned viability estimates are used to certify actions at deployment. translated_title: 面向离线安全强化学习的单调可行性学习
translated_abstract: 离线安全强化学习需要从固定数据中获得可靠的长时程安全估计。在这种设置下学习Hamilton-Jacobi（HJ）可行性，要求算法具备语义保持性、收敛性和数值稳定性。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了单调可行性学习（MoViL），通过单调的有限时程集合递归从离线转移数据中学习可行集。该递归保持了有限时程的安全语义，并收敛到无限时程的可行性核。二值监督在各时程上保持固定的目标尺度，避免了折扣因子引起的数值衰减。我们进一步建立了恢复行为支撑可行子集的充分条件。学到的可行性估计被用于在部署时对动作进行安全认证。Dubins车实验验证了所学可行集的数值精度。在安全强化学习基准上的评估表明该方法取得了最先进的奖励-（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出单调可行性学习（MoViL），通过单调有限时程集合递归从离线数据中学习可行集，在保持安全语义、收敛至无限时程可行性核的同时避免折扣引起的数值衰减，实现部署时可靠的动作安全认证。
en_tdlr: MoViL learns viable sets from offline data through a monotone finite-horizon set recursion that preserves safety semantics, converges to the infinite-horizon viability kernel, and avoids discount-induced numerical attenuation, enabling reliable action safety certification at deployment.
